messages:
alex: Quick check — proposing cut window: Thu Mar 31 18:00 UTC (2hr window). Can we do a short go/no-go at 14:00 PT tomorrow? Posting a lightweight readiness matrix below — please reply with Y/N + any blockers.

Readiness matrix (high level)
- QA: e2e failing on one streaming edge (raj)
- Infra: capacity + autoscale ready (kevin)
- Runtime: quantization deploy on staging OK (maria)
- Data/Telemetry: hooks in place but sample rate needs adjustment (sophie)
- Rollback: snapshot + canary runbook prepared (alex)

Agenda for go/no-go (30m)
1) Owner status updates (5m)
2) Risk highlights & blockers (10m)
3) Canary plan + smoke tests (10m)
4) Final decision + fallback owner (5m)

Please react with :white_check_mark: if you can attend 14:00 PT, :x: if not, and add a short note with blockers.

raj: ✅ I can make 14:00 PT. QA: e2e is flaking on long-context streaming test — investigating root cause, ETA for fix EOD tomorrow. If not fixed we should do canary with capped seq len.

kevin: :white_check_mark: infra good. I can allocate one more GPU from reserved pool for canary if needed — tagging @maria to confirm runtime needs.

maria: :white_check_mark: runtime looks stable on staging. Quantize path caused ~2% perf variance but within tolerance. I'll run a final perf sweep this afternoon and report.

sophie: :white_check_mark: telemetry hooks are in place, but staging currently samples debug logs at 100% — will reduce before cut. No blocker from my side.

alex: Noted. @raj if e2e not green we'll run canary with seq cap + disable streaming. @kevin please reserve the GPU and add @oncall-bot for standby during the window.

eng-release-bot: Reminder: please upload final release checklist to /releases/2026-03-31 by 13:00 PT — automated pre-cut checks will run at 13:15 PT.

kevin: Reserved 1 GPU and pinged oncall. @oncall-bot please add Sophie as rollback owner for the cut window.

oncall-bot: Sophie added to rollback rotation for 3/31 cut. Paging policy: 30m initial ping, escalate to infra leads after 15m.

maria: Quick ask — can we add a small post-cut health-check script to run automatically? I can push to infra repo but need a quick review from @kevin.

alex: Good idea. If you can't make the 14:00 PT slot, please nominate a proxy and confirm whether you can give an async thumbs-up. I'll Dm the calendar invite in a minute.

raj: If I'm still debugging I nominate @maria for runtime signoff. I'll post e2e results by 13:30 PT.

sophie: I won't be on the meeting but can be oncall during the cut window and monitor the rollout. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks all — sending calendar invite + agenda now. Please upload final checklists to the release folder and I'll do a final go/no-go ping at 13:45 PT.
